$comment: Index of custom WebMCP tools. Update this file whenever you add or change a tool. One entry per tool. namespace must equal the domain. status: draft | qa_passed | verified | broken. Entry fields: domain, tool, file (path under domains/), kind, url_patterns, status, qa_agent (agent id of the independent QA pass, or null), browser_session (live Kernel session id, or null when expired), last_verified (ISO date), notes.

tools.notes: Independent QA of the search implementation plus a live migration check from an expired booking page: 40 exact options. First-page outbound options, per-person from-fares; nearby airports and ground transport are labeled. Challenges and connection failures remain possible. Independent repeated-transition coverage of the radio mitigation and long-haul round-trip coverage remain incomplete; see the domain README.

Independent QA checked 60 flight options across six populated searches, plus no-results, invalid-input and offline cases. Domain-namespace migration verified live from /content/travel-info: SEA-SFO round trip returned 10 of 45 options. Adults only; outbound first page; displayed fares per adult, including round-trip starting fares rather than selected return flights. See domain README for limitations.

Independent targeted QA passed, including schema and synthetic parser/readiness regressions. A separate live DOM parse returned 20 rows; successful final full-tool invocation remains unverified due to intermittent Delta HTTP 429/SFAF001 failures. Domain migration invocation from a baggage page reached results and preserved explicit error output. Round trips return outbound options only; prices are displayed fares, not passenger totals. Real zero results and completeness beyond the 1.5-second DOM-quiescence heuristic remain unverified.

Live-verified: search-result entry reaches the login form and submits exactly once, and failures report the step and whether a submission happened. Success path unverified: Delta returns 'login is unavailable right now' to every Kernel browser, including one with no profile, while the same credentials work in an ordinary browser.

Core QA matrix passed; all 366 returned rows validated. Domain-namespace migration verified from /optional-services with 50 round-trip rows. Supervised use only: extended QA still found 3 stale-state errors in 24 valid-route calls and one timeout; no substituted flights returned. Adult-only; leg metadata fares are not checkout quotes. See domain README.

Independent search/parser QA passed; domain migration live-verified from /travel-agents. Returns initial outbound cards only, including round trips; 1–7 adults; displayed cash fares are not trip totals. Inventory failures remain explicit errors.
live success verified (logged_in:true, one submission, no MFA); failure path live-verified invalid_credentials; MFA/lockout synthetic only

First outbound results page only, including round trips; USD per adult per direction. Independent QA and live non-homepage invocation passed. Live zero-flight behavior remains unverified; synthetic empty/error/timeout tests passed. Long Browser REPL calls can time out before delivering results; see domain README.
live-verified captcha_or_challenge only; success path unverified — site challenges egress; solver loaded but idle

Independent QA passed; domain-namespace migration verified live from a non-homepage results page: 26 SFO-LAX itineraries in 29.309s. Adults, English/US cash fares, initial outbound page only; roundtrip starting fares are per person. Nearby airports are returned explicitly. Slow-search transport timeouts remain a risk.
